messages:
jamie: kicking off NEBULASHIFT rollout tonight in the 01:00-03:00 UTC change window. plan: shadow 5% -> canary 12% -> ramp to 50% -> 100% if metrics look good. fallback ordering: nebula-13b-q4 -> nebula-13b-int8 -> titan-1. pin policy: sessions that see >500ms p95 during canary will be pinned to previous model for 30m. deploy-bot will gate each step. links: https://go/release/nebula-shift (release notes)

deploy-bot: scheduled rollout job created by jamie at 2025-11-10T00:45:00Z. steps queued: shadow(5,10m), canary(12,30m), ramp(50,1h), full. notify @eng-oncall if error-rate > 0.5% OR p95 delta > 120ms.

anya: quick ask — is the hallucination regression eval set included in the canary checks? we should fail fast on semantic regressions.

jamie: yes — eval set v2 (prod-prompts-200) is in the guardrails. metrics: p95 latency, success rate, rerank accuracy, hallucination-score (failing threshold 0.03), cost-per-token delta.

rohan: reminder: KV cache warmup required for nebula-13b-q4; recommend pre-warm by replaying top-1000 prefixes 20m before canary. I can run a warmup job; will post logs.

ops-bot: warmup job scheduled: warmup-nebula-1739999999-01 at 2025-11-10T00:50:00Z.

tina: add a runtime feature-flag to flip fallback priority if we see increased latency on q4. can we roll a temporary priority override: fallback_priority = [nebula-13b-int8, titan-1] if p95 > baseline+100ms? That means we can avoid full rollback.

jamie: good call. I'll add a soft-priority-override to the rollout config. pseudocode:
```
rollout.config.fallback_policy = {
  default: [nebula-13b-q4, nebula-13b-int8, titan-1],
  emergency_latency_threshold_ms: 100,
  override_priority: [nebula-13b-int8, titan-1]
}
```

rohan: will also set cache TTL shorter for the first hour so old kv entries don't mask behavior.

deploy-bot: shadow step completed: 5% shadow traffic for 10m. metrics snapshot: p95 +10ms, error-rate 0.04%, hallucination-score 0.012. No automatic abort. Proceeding to canary in 5m.

tina: before canary -> confirm observability hooks: traces, token-level cost sampling, prompt-level eval with failing cases flagged. who owns the trace runbook if canary trips?

anya: I'll be on-call for the canary window. trace runbook: https://go/runbooks/model-canary. ops escalation: @eng-oncall -> @infra-lead.

jamie: canary started (12% traffic). keep telemetry tight. reminder: change window hard stop at 03:00 UTC — if unresolved, we pin back to titan-1 and open postmortem.

deploy-bot: canary snapshot @2025-11-10T01:25Z: p95 +95ms, error-rate 0.12%, hallucination-score 0.028. triggering soft-priority-override per config. switching fallback order.

rohan: seeing higher tail latencies on a subset of large context sessions. applying temporary pin for sessions > 32k tokens.

tina: running hallucination quick-eval on the flagged sample. if hallucination-score > 0.03 we force rollback. current sample: 0.031 -> borderline.

anya: recommend hold ramp. jamie, can we freeze at 12% until we finish the quick-eval and warmup completes?

jamie: freezing ramp. canceling scheduled 50% step. notified @product-led about delay. tagging release notes with the reason.

deploy-bot: ramp canceled. state: canary-frozen. all downstream automated ramps suppressed.

tina: next steps proposal: 1) finish warmup (rohan), 2) run expanded hallucination eval (anya), 3) re-evaluate metrics in 30m. if hallucination-score drops <0.025 and p95 < baseline+80ms -> proceed to 50%. else rollback to titan-1.

rohan: warmup progress: 60% done, replay throughput 1200req/s; ETA 12m.

anya: running expanded eval now, sending results in 8m.

deploy-bot: note — manual pin applied: sessions >32k tokens pinned to titan-1 for 30m. automation: if pin count >1% of active sessions, abort rollout.

jamie: thanks team. keeping the thread updated. will push a short blurb to #release-notes after final decision. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: final state @2025-11-10T02:42Z: canary unfreeze decision pending. last metric snapshot: p95 +60ms, error-rate 0.06%, hallucination-score 0.022. awaiting jamie decision.

jamie: proceeding to 50% ramp at 02:50 UTC. will monitor for 15m, then evaluate for full cutover. if anything spikes -> immediate rollback and postmortem.

tina: good. I'll keep an eye and start preparing the rollback ticket template in case.

anya: results post-50% check — stable so far. hallucination-score steady at 0.021. no abnormal error spikes.

deploy-bot: ramp to 50% completed at 2025-11-10T02:57Z. scheduled check in 15m.

jamie: if everything stays green we aim for full rollout at 03:10 UTC. note to docs: add 'soft-priority-override' entry to rollout ops guide.

rohan: logging warmup artifacts to /var/logs/warmup/nebula-1739999999.log

deploy-bot: full-rollout completed at 2025-11-10T03:12Z. final snapshot: p95 +35ms, error-rate 0.03%, hallucination-score 0.019. release notes updated.

jamie: closing thread. postmortem not required. will follow up with micro-post to #product and #support about minor latency blip during canary. :tada:
